You ensure their execution, profitability, and compliance with the commitments made to sponsors. Instead, you mobilize and coordinate shared resources across IGNITY — senior experts, finance and administrative functions, the events team — as well as external partners, subcontractors and members of international consortia. Planning, prioritizing, delegating, and securing stakeholder commitment are at the core of this role. Key responsibilities: - Lead programs end to end: planning, deliverables, deadlines, and each stakeholder's responsibilities. - Orchestrate IGNITY's shared internal resources based on program needs, arbitrating workload and priorities. - Coordinate external partners, subcontractors, and European and international consortia. - Anticipate risks of overload or slippage and trigger the necessary corrective actions. - Act as the operational point of contact for programs, for internal teams, partners, start-ups and sponsors. - Protect the scope: challenge stakeholders, push back with a well-argued "no" when necessary, and work with the Business Development Manager to identify opportunities for Change Requests. - Own the financial and administrative steering of programs: budget, invoicing, reporting, audits, and contractual obligations. - Drive on-the-ground activities — bootcamps, workshops, challenges, training sessions, matchmaking — in Belgium and abroad. - Secure the satisfaction of sponsors and partners, key to renewing programs. - Structure and improve IGNITY's ways of working to enable the company to scale. - Contribute to business development, identifying new opportunities alongside the Business Development Manager. WHAT IGNITY OFFERS YOU - A direct impact on the technology start-up ecosystem. - An international network of European partners, institutions and defense innovation players. - An entrepreneurial environment, within a fast-growing organization. - The chance to build deep expertise in defense and security. Company Description Sports Excitement is a global sports community platform designed to connect athletes, families, and fans in a single interactive space. The platform will work like a social network tailored specifically to sports, helping parents easily register children for teams and leagues while enabling users to follow their favorite sports, teams, and athletes. Sports Excitement will be free to download, with revenue generated through advertisements and premium features that help users expand their sports networks. The upcoming website launch will give early access to features and content as the community grows. By filling a unique niche in the sports industry, Sports Excitement aims to become the go-to destination for discovering sports opportunities and sharing a passion for athletics. Internship Overview The Product Management Internship — UI/UX & Design Systems at Sports Excitement is a remote, unpaid, three-month learning opportunity designed for individuals interested in gaining practical exposure to product management in a sports technology environment. Interns will work with a designated supervisor and collaborate with product, design, and development team members on supervised projects involving customer discovery, UI/UX collaboration, product requirements, user flows, product analytics, and Agile development practices. The internship is intended to provide participants with hands-on experience across different stages of the product lifecycle, while helping them strengthen skills in product thinking, documentation, research, analytics, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Responsibilities & Learning Opportunities Participate in user research and customer discovery activities, including user interviews, note-taking, and organizing qualitative feedback. Assist with synthesizing research findings into user needs, customer problem statements, user personas, and product insights. Support the creation and refinement of Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria. Gain experience writing structured acceptance criteria using formats such as Given-When-Then when appropriate. Collaborate with UX and product design team members to review wireframes, user flows, and interactive prototypes. Support usability reviews and help identify opportunities to improve clarity, accessibility, navigation, and overall user experience. Gain exposure to design systems and help document or organize reusable UI patterns, components, and product design standards where applicable. Assist with mapping onboarding flows, user funnels, and other product journeys. Support the review and organization of basic product metrics, including engagement, retention, and user behavior data. Gain exposure to experimentation concepts such as A/B testing and hypothesis-driven product development. Participate in Agile team activities such as sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives. Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and other team members while receiving feedback and guidance throughout the internship. Document product decisions, requirements, assumptions, user insights, and relevant trade-offs. Qualifications Foundational understanding of product management, UI/UX, user-centered design, customer discovery, or Agile software development. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an interest in understanding user needs and identifying root causes. Ability to organize information and communicate ideas clearly in written and verbal formats. Interest in learning how to write product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation. Basic understanding of user journeys, wireframes, prototypes, or digital product experiences. Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. Relevant coursework, training, personal projects, portfolio work, volunteer experience, or other practical experience in Product Management, Business, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, UX/UI Design, Data Analytics, or a related field is welcomed. Interest in sports, technology, digital communities, or consumer-facing platforms is a plus. Preferred Tools & Experience Experience with the following is helpful but not required: Figma or similar design and prototyping tools Notion, Jira, Confluence, or similar product/project documentation tools Basic analytics or product analytics platforms Agile or Scrum workflows User research or usability testing Product requirement documentation Design systems or component libraries Academic, personal, volunteer, and non-commercial project experience is welcome. Academic Credit & School Verification Academic credit may be available depending on the requirements and approval of the intern’s college or university. Candidates are responsible for confirming eligibility and academic-credit requirements directly with their educational institution. Sports Excitement can support reasonable internship verification requirements from participating educational institutions. Any academic credit is awarded solely by the intern’s educational institution and is not guaranteed by Sports Excitement. Internship Structure This internship is expected to last approximately three months , with a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week . Interns will have an assigned supervisor and will participate remotely. Scheduling and internship responsibilities may be coordinated with the intern and supervisor based on project needs and, when applicable, academic requirements. Equal Opportunity Sports Excitement welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds and evaluates candidates based on relevant skills, experience, interests, and their ability to contribute to and learn from the internship experience.

Acompanhar a implementação das soluções e assegurar uma adequada passagem para as equipas responsáveis pelo suporte e acompanhamento pós-venda. Analisar e validar soluções de integração entre equipamentos, software e sistemas de automação industrial. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas técnicas para garantir a viabilidade e correta implementação das soluções.
